archetype: High Fantasy Browser MMO / League of Angels Style
theme: Dark High-Fantasy (Dark-brown/black panels, metallic gold frames, glowing turquoise water, violet/magenta magic, excessive ornate gold embellishments)
instructions_to_main_agent: This application is a 2.5D Browser Fishing MMORPG inspired by classic Asian web MMOs like League of Angels and Heaven's Fury.

The overall visual style MUST be lavish, over-the-top high fantasy: dark brown/black semi-translucent panels with ornate metallic gold borders, round gold-ringed buttons, huge gold gradient Battle Rating (BR) counters, red notification dots with white '!' badges, and vibrant particle glows.
The core viewport consists of a fixed 3/4 isometric perspective world canvas (PixiJS or HTML5 Canvas fallback) with a full React DOM HUD overlay on top.
Include a full Login/Register/Guest landing screen with character class selection (e.g., Celestial Angler, Leviathan Slayer, Arcane Fisher) before entering the game world.

In-game HUD Layout: Top-left portrait, Level, VIP badge, BR (Battle Rating) display, Stamina & Gold/Diamond currencies; Top-right event icon grid (2 rows) with red notification dots, Minimap, Channel switcher; Right Fishing Tracker & Leaderboard preview; Left rail Quests/Daily/Pass/Ranks; Bottom Chat Box with tabs (World/Guild/System), quick-slot consumables, and a large central gold FISH button with action sub-buttons.

Tension Fishing Minigame: Active interactive minigame bar featuring color zones (red | orange | yellow | green | yellow | orange | red), moving needle, line tension indicator, fish resistance animations, and 'Keep needle in the green zone!' callout.
Catch Reward Modal: Flashy reward popup with rarity frame styling (Common: Gray/Silver, Uncommon: Green, Rare: Blue, Epic: Purple, Legendary: Gold, Mythic: Iridescent Red/Magenta with particle aura).
Modals needed: Inventory & Bulk Sell, Fishdex (Collection album with stats & lore), Gear Shop & Rod/Lure Refine/Enhance system, VIP Privileges, Leaderboards, Quest Log.
Landscape-first design with a responsive 'Please rotate your device to landscape mode' overlay when opened in portrait on mobile.
Ensure all interactive elements and data fields include explicit `data-testid` attributes.

viewports.landing_page: Full-screen epic fantasy background artwork, floating particle effects, title logo, server select dropdown, account login / register tab switcher, Quick Guest Play CTA.
viewports.game_canvas: Full viewport 2.5D isometric water environment with floating fishing spots, animated ripple particles, fish shadows under water, player avatar with glowing wings and fishing rod.
viewports.hud_overlay: Absolute full-screen overlay (pointer-events-none on transparent zones, pointer-events-auto on interactive panels) with fixed position anchors for Top-Left Player Bar, Top-Right Grid, Left Quests, Right Tracker, Bottom Controls.

hud_zones.top_left: Character Portrait with level ring, Name, VIP status tag, BR gauge, HP/Stamina bars, Gold and Diamond counters with '+' buy buttons.
hud_zones.top_right: 2 rows of 6 circular event icons (Daily Check-in, 7-Day Carnival, First Top-up, World Boss Fish, Wheel of Fortune, Mystery Shop, etc.), Minimap radar with fish density indicators, Channel Switcher (Ch. 1 - Hot).
hud_zones.left_rail: Collapsible Quest & Event Tracker panel (Main Story, Daily Trials, Guild Orders) with auto-pathing/auto-fish buttons.
hud_zones.right_rail: Active Spot Fish Species list, Current Catch Streak, Regional Leaderboard snippet.
hud_zones.bottom_center: Huge circular Gold 'FISH / CAST' button with tension indicator ring, flanked by Lure Selector, Rod Skill 1, Rod Skill 2, and Auto-Fish Toggle.
hud_zones.bottom_left: Compact Chat Box with tabs [World, Guild, System, Whisper] and quick emoji reactions.

key_functionalities: Authentication: Login, Register, and One-click Guest Play with character creation (Name, Avatar, Class).
2.5D World Viewport: Rendered sea/lake with water shader effect, player character with animated wings/aura, casting animation, fish shadows.
Tension Minigame: Real-time needle balance minigame. Tap/hold button to pull rod, raising tension needle into green safe band while avoiding red snapped-line territory.
Catch Reward Popup: Dramatic reveal with rays of light, rarity sound effect triggers, fish weight (kg), rarity tier tag, exp gained, and sell/keep options.
Inventory System: Grid layout with rarity color borders, item tooltips, filter tabs (Fish, Lures, Rods, Baits, Materials), and 'Batch Sell Fish' button.
Fishdex: Encyclopedia listing all collectible aquatic beasts across zones with progress percentage, lore, and completion stat bonuses.
Gear Shop & Refining: Upgrade Fishing Rod level, socket Lures, upgrade Wings for massive BR boosts.
Battle Rating (BR): Consolidated power score recalculated dynamically when equipping higher tier gear or catching Mythic fish.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements must feature lower-kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='cast-fish-button', data-testid='inventory-modal-toggle', data-testid='br-display-value', data-testid='tension-bar-needle').
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standards: Text over panels must maintain high contrast (light amber or white text on dark brown backgrounds with text shadows). Never use transparent backgrounds under text labels.
testing_and_accessibility.orientation_check: Include landscape reminder prompt when screen width < screen height on mobile devices.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use generic modern flat UI designs — this app MUST feel like an over-the-top high fantasy web MMORPG.
Use lush dark brown panels with gold gradient borders (`border-amber-500/80 bg-stone-950/90 shadow-2xl shadow-yellow-900/40`).
Incorporate red notification dots with '!' on event buttons to capture the classic web game aesthetic.
Battle Rating (BR) must be prominently displayed with gold typography and glow effects.
Ensure all modal dialogs have explicit gold-framed headers with close ('X') buttons.
Add interactive audio-visual feedback (vibration/flashes on minigame, particle effects on legendary catch).
All code is in React JS (.js files).
Always include comprehensive data-testid attributes for testing.
